description: Metrô is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Dados relativos à rede de Metrô do Distrito Federal, no ano de 2009, com as respectivas Regiões Administrativas interligadas por esse meio de transporte. Fornecer informações a respeito das linhas de metrô do Distrito Federal. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are metro, metropolitano, trem urbano. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
